key_highlights: ASX 200 (^AXJO) pressured by Wall Street correction contagion, but local resources stage a defensive rebound.
Macro headwinds mount as Australian flash PMI plunges into contraction and AUD/USD short positioning reaches extremes.
Banking and discretionary retail face margin pressure from cumulative RBA rate hikes, compressed borrowing capacity, and consumer slowdown.
Active junior/mid-tier exploration in gold, copper, and rare earths offers selective outperformance amid China property distress.

sectors.trend: Miners rebound despite broad market wobbles, led by gold development and critical minerals, though Chinese property weakness curbs bulk upside.
sectors.implications: Bullish on gold and copper explorers; selective caution on pure-play iron ore exposed to Chinese residential construction.

sectors.trend: Credit growth constrained by cumulative RBA tightening, reduced borrowing capacity, and scrutiny over APRA's 3% serviceability buffer.
sectors.implications: Margin compression and modest loan growth for major banks; potential rise in credit impairment risks if macro deterioration persists.

sectors.trend: Domestic gas supply deficits persist alongside grid transition challenges and surging power requirements from emerging data centres.
sectors.implications: Favourable pricing backdrop for domestic gas producers, but long-term energy transition and capex execution hurdles remain elevated.

sectors.trend: Discretionary retail faces acute demand weakness and store survival battles, while staples navigate compliance and supply chain remediations.
sectors.implications: Defensive rotation toward essential food retail over discretionary retail exposed to disposable income squeeze.

key_themes: Global equity contagion vs domestic resources buffer as Wall Street enters correction territory.
Australian macroeconomic deterioration highlighted by flash PMI contraction and Treasurer warnings.
Structural headwinds in Chinese real estate threatening medium-term bulk commodity demand.
Extreme speculative short positioning on the Australian dollar amid rising global risk aversion.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Increase cash reserves and portfolio allocations to gold producers and defensive market-neutral strategies.
Underweight cyclical retail and commercial REITs; overweight high-quality non-cyclical defensive earners.
Diversify materials exposure away from bulk iron ore into gold, copper, and critical minerals.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Extreme AUD Depreciation and FX Volatility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Allocate to ASX-listed global earners with unhedged USD revenues to capture positive translation effects.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Gold and Critical Minerals Producers
opportunities.rationale: Strong commodity support, multiple exploration discoveries, and safe-haven demand buffer against broader equity sell-offs.

opportunities.recommendation: Long USD-Earning Healthcare and Global Exporters
opportunities.rationale: Deep AUD/USD short positioning provides foreign exchange translation tailwinds for offshore revenues.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce Exposure to Major Retail Banks and Discretionary Retail
defensive_moves.rationale: High mortgage burden, reduced borrowing power, and weak flash PMI indicate slowing credit demand and discretionary spending.
Wall Street correction risks spillover to the ASX 200 (^AXJO); hedging preserves capital during volatile sessions.

market_outlook.short_term: Elevated volatility across the ASX 200 (^AXJO) over the next 1–3 months as markets absorb US equity correction fallout and soft domestic macro indicators.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month performance will depend on RBA easing trajectory, China property stabilising policies, and resilient export earnings from diversified miners.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy decisions and cash rate commentary
China property sector policy interventions and iron ore demand data
Domestic quarterly GDP and inflation prints following PMI contraction
Wall Street benchmark stabilisation after recent correction
watch_list: AUD/USD exchange rate movements against extreme speculative short levels
Iron ore (62% Fe CFR China) and spot gold (AUD/oz) prices
Mortgage arrears rates across major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX)
APRA regulatory statements on mortgage buffer requirements
